academicJudgment.claimTested: The confirmed120ECfirst-two-year criminological core supports a meaningful broader UCR response through actual criminal-law/criminological research, behavioural and social explanation, prevention, racialized crime/punishment inquiry and empirical/economic methods. A second coherent direction emphasizes institutional/legal and policy responses. This is not full-degree, specialist-training or culminating-research equivalence.
academicJudgment.finding: Give those gaps full weight. UCR Criminal Law and Criminal Justice includes criminological/organized-crime research design, legal responsibility and punishment; Youth Resilience to Extremism teaches radicalization, risks/protection and evidence-based prevention with an actual recipient-reviewed project; Media and Race directly examines crime, punishment, incarceration and extremist propaganda. These substantive anchors combine with sustained social theory, qualitative fieldwork, R-based multivariate methods, economic choice/efficiency and behavioral development. This is a defensible broader response to the confirmed core, not a specialist Dutch Criminology degree. The policy direction retains those anchors while changing institutional/legal and public-response priorities.
academicJudgment.strongestObjection: A generic law/psychology/social-science palette could obscure the actual criminological organizing subject, including offender/victim explanation, specialized police/prosecution practice, forensic evidence, cybercrime, economic crime policy and an integrated criminological research sequence. Excluding later unknown study cannot erase gaps already inside the confirmed core.

If it adds intensive Dutch procedure, detention, drugs/organized crime or specialist culmination, full-degree comparability could change; none is used to support the core claim. Elective capacity/eligibility does not provide assumed academic contents. Known victimology, spatial criminology, police/prosecution, cybercrime and witness-method gaps remain visible in the core itself.
